why: All-rounders: instead of riding one signal (momentum, clusters and streaks all came up short), take the numbers that look good from every angle at once. 39 and 77 each sit in the top 6 of seven different policies and 44 in six across the long-run, short-run and pair families; 44 and 39 were drawn at least 7 times in every 25-game quarter (the steadiest numbers in the window). 72 completes it: 33 in 100, 8 in the last 20, steady in every quarter.
